title: Oura Stress vs HRV Deviation
dataSources: Oura stress and recovery (`oura:stress`), CPAP therapy sessions (`cpap:session`), oral thermometer readings (`thermometer:reading`), and body-composition scale snapshots (`bodycomp:reading`).
app: Personal health telemetry from Oura, OSCAR CPAP exports, oral thermometer readings, and smart body-composition scales sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and CSV exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:stress
| stats avg(stress_score) as avg_stress_score avg(hrv_delta_ms) as avg_hrv_delta_ms by day_type
| sort 0 - avg_stress_score
description: Ranks day typess by stress and HRV deviation.
value: Stress plus HRV deviation shows whether the body is absorbing load or struggling under it.
implementation: Send stress and HRV deviation events to `index=personal` and keep `day_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of stress and HRV deviation by day types.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which day typess stand out most for stress and HRV deviation.
